fills.reason: No external/shared-storage APIs (getExternal*, MediaStore) or WRITE/MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permissions; receipts, backups and thumbnails go to filesDir/cacheDir, and CSV export uses a user-picked SAF document.
Looked for SecretKeySpec or key byte arrays; all AES keys are generated in AndroidKeyStore via KeyGenerator, none hardcoded.
No android.util.Log, println, Logger or printStackTrace calls in app or sync sources; the OkHttp logging interceptor is only added when BuildConfig.DEBUG, at BASIC level with Authorization redacted.
The only WebView enables JavaScript but sets allowContentAccess = false and never enables setAllowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs.
The only WebView sets allowFileAccess = false and never enables file-URL access settings (minSdk 26).

The 'Private note' field, whose content the app treats as sensitive (it encrypts it with a Keystore key before storage), is a plain OutlinedTextField with no non-caching keyboard options, so the keyboard may learn it. The password uses OutlinedSecureTextField.

evidence.detail: Private note field uses default (caching) keyboard options.

fills.reason: No FLAG_SECURE or other screen-capture prevention anywhere; the app shows financial data and decrypted private notes on the expense list.

evidence.detail: Content is set without window FLAG_SECURE.
Decrypted private note shown on an unprotected screen.

fills.reason: Searched app and sync sources for Notification/NotificationCompat builders and POST_NOTIFICATIONS: the app posts no notifications.
The only access-code field (password) uses OutlinedSecureTextField with default obfuscation, never set to Visible; there are no OTP fields.

JS is enabled and HelpBridge is added, but its methods only return the app version and close the activity, and the WebView only loads https URLs on the help.pennyjar.example host (others go to the browser).

No filterTouchesWhenObscured, onFilterTouchEventForSecurity, obscured-flag checks or setHideOverlayWindows anywhere, while the app has a login screen and a delete-account confirmation; targetSdk is 36.

evidence.detail: Password entry has no overlay/tapjacking protection.

fills.reason: Internal navigation to HelpActivity uses an explicit Intent(context, HelpActivity::class.java); the implicit intents (ACTION_VIEW to the browser, ACTION_SEND choosers) delegate to external user-chosen apps.
The only implicit intents with extras are ACTION_SEND wrapped in createChooser for user-initiated sharing of a share link or a receipt image; no tokens or credentials in extras.
Searched app and sync sources for PendingIntent.get*: none are created.
The manifests declare no http/https deep links; the only VIEW/BROWSABLE filter uses the custom pennyjar scheme.

HelpActivity reads the 'page' query parameter and loads it in the WebView only if the scheme is https and the host equals help.pennyjar.example; otherwise it hands only http/https URLs to the browser.
Security values (biometric secret, share-link token) use SecureRandom; the only kotlin.random.Random use picks an avatar colour from a merchant name.
No currentTimeMillis/Date/Calendar-derived values are used for tokens, keys or IVs; IVs come from Cipher and tokens from SecureRandom.
The single key generator creates 256-bit AES keys in AndroidKeyStore; there are no asymmetric keys.
All Cipher.getInstance calls use AES/GCM/NoPadding and KeyGenerator uses AES; no DES, 3DES, RC4 or Blowfish.
Every transformation is AES/GCM/NoPadding; no ECB or bare 'AES'.
The app calls BiometricManager.canAuthenticate(BIOMETRIC_STRONG), which the test accepts as a secure-lock check, before enabling and using biometric unlock.
No KeyPairGenerator or asymmetric keys in the code; the only Keystore keys are symmetric AES keys for encrypt/decrypt.
The only provider named is AndroidKeyStore (KeyStore and KeyGenerator); Cipher.getInstance calls name no provider.
BiometricPrompt allows only BIOMETRIC_STRONG; DEVICE_CREDENTIAL and setDeviceCredentialAllowed are not used.

authenticate() is always called with a CryptoObject wrapping a Cipher whose key is generated with setUserAuthenticationRequired(true). Note that the unlocked secret only gates the UI; the session token is not bound to it.
The biometric key is created with setInvalidatedByBiometricEnrollment(true).
The PromptInfo builder never calls setConfirmationRequired(false); the default (confirmation required) applies.
The biometric key uses setUserAuthenticationParameters(0, AUTH_BIOMETRIC_STRONG) on API 30+ and setUserAuthenticationValidityDurationSeconds(-1) (per-use) below; no duration > 0.
Neither OkHttp client sets ConnectionSpec/tlsVersions, and there are no SSLContext.getInstance or setEnabledProtocols calls; OkHttp defaults apply.
The only http:// URL (http://10.0.2.2:8080/) is the debug build type's API_BASE_URL; release uses https://api.pennyjar.example/ and all other endpoints are https.
Searched app and sync sources for SSLSocket/SSLSocketFactory: none; all networking goes through OkHttp.
No custom X509TrustManager or checkServerTrusted in app or sync sources; OkHttp uses the platform trust manager.
No custom HostnameVerifier in app or sync sources; OkHttp's default verifier is used.
The HelpActivity WebViewClient overrides only shouldOverrideUrlLoading, not onReceivedSslError, so SSL errors cancel by default.
The app never calls ProviderInstaller.installIfNeeded(Async) before making network connections; the OkHttp clients are built at application start without updating the security provider.

evidence.detail: Network clients are created at startup without a prior security provider update.

fills.reason: No setWebContentsDebuggingEnabled call in app or sync sources.
shouldOverrideUrlLoading allows in-WebView navigation only when the scheme is https and the host exactly equals help.pennyjar.example; everything else goes to the browser.
No EnableSafeBrowsing meta-data in the manifests and no setSafeBrowsingEnabled(false) call in code.
The project has no native code (no .so, C/C++ sources, CMake or externalNativeBuild) and no direct dependency that ships native libraries.
The project has no native code (no .so, C/C++ sources, CMake or externalNativeBuild) and no direct dependency that ships native libraries.
The app checks Build.VERSION.SDK_INT against VERSION_CODES.R when configuring the biometric key.
No SBOM is in the project, and generating one needs a Gradle build; run an SBOM scan (e.g. CycloneDX + OSV) on the release build to cover transitive and BOM-managed versions.

The only deserialization is Gson into fixed data classes (Session, Created) from the app's own HTTPS API; no ObjectInputStream, Parcelable or Serializable extras from other apps (HelpActivity only reads a String extra).

Whether the biometric lock screen is shown depends only on a plain SharedPreferences boolean (settings.xml) with no HMAC or signature, and settings.xml is not excluded from backup, so flipping it skips the lock.

evidence.detail: Biometric-lock flag read from SharedPreferences without integrity check.
The unverified flag decides whether the app locks.

fills.reason: ReceiptsProvider (not exported) builds queries with bound arguments: merchant path segment is a ? parameter in rawQuery, ids are bound, and caller-supplied selection strings are ignored.
No Play In-App Updates API and no backend minimum-version check: startup goes straight from session restore to the app's screens.

evidence.detail: Startup flow has no update-enforcement check.

fills.reason: No signingConfig in the build files and no built APK, so the enabled signature schemes can't be read; check the release APK with apksigner verify --verbose.
The signing key isn't in the project (no signingConfig or keystore); check the release APK's signer key size with apksigner.
No StrictMode references in app or sync sources.
The project builds no native binaries (no .so, C/C++ sources or externalNativeBuild).
No root detection: no su/Magisk/test-keys checks, no root-detection library and no Play Integrity in code or dependencies.

evidence.detail: App startup performs no root check.

fills.reason: No debugger detection: no Debug.isDebuggerConnected, TracerPid or ptrace checks in code, and no native code.

evidence.detail: App startup performs no debugger check.

fills.reason: Release enables R8 (isMinifyEnabled with proguard-android-optimize) and keeps only HelpBridge's JS methods, but strings stay plaintext; how readable the security logic is needs a look at the decompiled release APK.
The project has no native libraries.

The app sends user data to the Mixpanel SDK: identify() with the account's user ID and an expense_added event with spending category, amount band and whether a photo/place was attached (financial info). Tracking is opted out until the user consents, but this still needs to be declared.

evidence.detail: Expense category and amount band shared with Mixpanel.
